conditions.text: units first receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits (r-0027 coverage text)

rules.support: r-0027 coverage text: units first receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the Rent Ordinance's rent increase limits; own text: applies to rent-controlled units
rules.reasoning: The allowable increase applies to rent-controlled units, and r-0027 says units first getting a certificate of occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent limits, so coverage is units first occupied on or before that date.
rules.plain_en: Landlords of rent-controlled San Francisco units can raise rent by no more than 1.6% of base rent from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

conditions.text: protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions

rules.support: own text: applies to affordable housing decisions affecting residents with arrest or conviction history
rules.reasoning: The record limits coverage to affordable housing decisions, a status that parcel data cannot show, and no sibling record adds a building test.
rules.plain_en: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects people with an arrest or conviction history when affordable housing decisions are made; the record gives no further details.

conditions.value: evicted for owner move-in or Ellis Act withdrawal
conditions.text: Tenants evicted for an owner move-in or for removal of the property from the rental market under the Ellis Act
same relocation payments as the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; evictions of tenants in units covered by the ordinance (r-0034)

rules.support: own text and interaction (relocation payments tied to the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance); r-0034 coverage text (fully or partially covered units)
rules.reasoning: The record covers tenants evicted for owner move-in or Ellis Act withdrawal, a tenancy-specific test, and ties the payments to the Rent Ordinance, whose covered units are given by r-0034.
rules.plain_en: Berkeley landlords must pay relocation assistance, adjusted yearly for inflation, when they evict a tenant for an owner move-in or to take a unit off the rental market.

result.notes: Second look: r-0026 uses the June 13, 1979 certificate-of-occupancy cut-off stated in r-0027. r-0028 and r-0033 are conditional because their records state who is covered, in tenancy or status terms that parcel data cannot test.
